notes.title: V1.4 - Quality of Unaliving II
notes.content:
Finally, a new INCARNAGE update. Fixed a few things that broke, added a timer to campaign playthroughs + a ranking system for that, and some pumpkin decorations on the menu for the spooky season.

[b]Full Changelog:[/b]
> Campaign Changes
[i]- Added an 'End Stats' screen after the campaign ending
- Added a 'total minutes played' statistic for campaign speedrunning
- Added a 'personal best time' statistic for campaign run comparisons
- Readded missing music in 'Desktop Destruction'
- Fixed some Skullsoldiers with detatched pivot points in 'Resistance HQ'
- Removed Motion Blur effect from 'Crossing Point'
- Added more Heavy Assault Rifle pickups to 'Gateway'
- Added more Shotguns lying around the mall floor in 'Shopping Spree'
- Fixed the trigger at the end of 'Caged Depths' sometimes not working
- Fixed the gun at the end of 'Caged Depths' not disappearing when picked up
- Added an additional hint for progression in 'Caged Depths'
- Added a ranking system to the 'End Stats' screen based on total minutes played[/i]

> Polishing & Improvements
[i]- There's a little theme for the main menu now
- Added a Game Volume slider to settings to change global sound volume
- Bullets now have a subtle white outline around them for better view
- The splash screen now takes the piss out of Unity, 'cause screw those guys
- Added changing menu decorations for Halloween and Christmas[/i]

> General Bug Fixes
[i]- Fixed drastic scaling issues with HUD elements & Comic Cutscenes
- Fixed broken timer placement in Dungeon Mode
- Fixed the Pistol being silent when fired[/i]

Happy Halloween... and stay tuned for big news.
-Elias

notes.title: v1.3 - Quality of Unaliving I
notes.content:
Here's the first general quality update for the game, fixing a few bugs and adding some improvements that I couldn't fit in prior to release...  ...mostly legs....

[b]Full Changelog (Contains Campaign Spoilers):[/b]
> Changes to 'Resistance HQ'
[i]   - Moved Dash tutorial sign to make tutorial pathway more noticeable
   - Added some Crank Rifles in the first room to pickup (in case you drop yours early)
   - Removed some enemys to help with pacing
   - Added another secret in the walls[/i]

> Additional Level Changes
[i]   - Pipes now emit ambient smoke in 'Sewer Outskirts'
   - Added a ladder to the end of 'Shifting Chambers'
   - Fixed some broken weapon pickup colliders in 'Alterk Lab'
   - Fixed the blue gate opening without needing the blue keycard in 'Torture Chambers'
   - Added an Achievement for beating the final boss on Deathwish difficulty (Have fun >:3)[/i]

> Polishing & Improvements
[i]   - Bullets are now sprites and render in front of quads
   - SSG bullets use a brighter bullet texture now
   - Added light Footstep noises to walking
   - Added physics to previously-levitating SkullSoldier corpses
   - Walking over the heads of SkullSoldier corpses crushes them
   - Meatcages now have a 50% chance of losing their rib-fins upon death
   - Added ambient smoke to all floor vent decorations
   - Player will trail bloody footprints after walking through blood
   - Added an additional blood pool decal to enemy gibbing
   - Added legs to SkullSoldier
   - Added legs to Bulldozer
   - Added legs to TacTrooper
   - Added legs to Cultists
   - Added additional explosive effects to Cultist death animation
   - Added legs to Bone Golems
   - Added heavier footstep noises to Mechs and Bone Golems
   - Added legs to Hawkshots (even though they're always out of view)
   - Added legs to Berserkrs
   - Added legs to Zombies
   - Added legs to The Police
   - Added legs to the final enemy[/i]

> General Bug Fixes
 [i]  - Fixed issue where blood particles sometimes caused audio to cut out
   - Fixed issue where weapon pickups wouldn't work if you recently dropped a weapon beforehand
   - Goop Jars now shatter on collision with the player to prevent getting stuck on them
   - Floor vent decorations no longer have colliders for smoother movement[/i]

That's all! Have fun and stuff!
- Elias

Full Changelog:

There may or may not be more achievements added in future updates... No promises!

Full Changelog:

- Blood spill decal colour changed to be slightly see through
- Fixed blood particles from only appearing above player and entities
- Removed the goofy rug at the end of 'Desktop Destruction'
- Fixed spawning symbols not despawning in 'Construction Site'
- Removed camera shake from explosions for easier viewing
- Added smoke particles to explosions
- Added trailing flesh strands to head explosion particles
- Added funny eyeballs to head explosion particles
- Sound effect added when bullets don't damage an enemy
- 'Gunheads' now make firing sounds when shooting
- Speed and particle amount increased for torso explosion gibs[/i]

Sorry for the long wait for an update... PC broke.
- Elias

notes.title: DUNGEON MODE - DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Introducing Dungeon Mode...[/b]
The endless mode within the demo has been rebuilt from scratch and replaced with 'Dungeon Mode', with improved loading times and a better balance of load-time and gameplay. 
Rather than interrupting the flow of gameplay with loading sections [i]within[/i] the endless mode, the mode will now generate set-length levels similar to the handmade levels featured in the Campaign Mode.
Dungeon mode also features a timer if you've got a need for speed-iness, and lets you choose any of the available weapons in the demo to tackle the level.

The finished game will feature multiple versions of Dungeon Mode, increasing in difficulty and varying in the used enemies & props.

So to recap the entire update:
- Removed previous unfinished endless mode
- Added 'Dungeon Mode' (Random Level Generator)
- Added additional menu screen for the endless modes
- Added an ESC option to return to the menu
- Added option to toggle fullscreen (still working on screen res)
- General other bug fixes
